business_summary.text: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited is a distinguished name in the textile and apparel industry, with a diversified product portfolio comprising fabrics (80%), garments (15%), and others (5%). The company is expanding its retail presence through ZECODE and DEVO stores.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 12%, EBITDA margin at 14% (including 150 bps retail impact)
FY27 capex at ₹100 Cr, with ₹40-50 Cr allocated to retail expansion
Consumer sentiment positive for festive season despite Adhik Maas postponement in Q1
Retail expansion funded through internal accruals; debt-to-equity at 0.24 as on 30th June '26
Real estate project: construction to start in Q2FY27, expected completion in 24 months
